steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: On the OT‑2, select 1–3 source‑destination plate pairs, choose the desired labware, and ensure tip racks are loaded; the run will pause for tip refilling if depleted.

steps.title: Add individual serum to source plates
steps.instruction: Dispense the designated serum samples into the appropriate wells of the source plates.

steps.title: Serially dilute serum in source plates
steps.instruction: Perform a serial dilution of the serum down the source plates as specified.

steps.title: Add virus to plates
steps.instruction: Add the SARS‑CoV‑2 (VSV) virus to each well of the source plates.

steps.title: Incubate plates (first)
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates for the required time under the appropriate conditions.

steps.title: Discard media from plates
steps.instruction: Remove and discard the media from each well.

steps.title: Transfer media to destination plates
steps.instruction: Transfer the remaining media from the source plate wells to the corresponding wells of the destination plates.

steps.title: Incubate plates (second)
steps.instruction: Incubate the destination plates again for the required time.

steps.title: Dispense overlay onto plates
steps.instruction: Add the overlay solution to each well of the plates.
